_comment: Protect tokens -- carried items that auto-negate a threat's consequence once, then are consumed (removed from inventory). Checked automatically the moment a threat's consequence would fire (THREAT ENGINE, dojotools_zenzork.yaml). If no protect token is carried, a CON saving throw (d20 + CON mod vs the threat's save_dc in threat_defs.json) is still rolled as a last chance before the consequence proceeds -- lite 5e flavor, character-sheet-driven rather than a hard binary.

tokens.flavor_dungeon:
*** PROTECT TOKEN CONSUMED: SALT CIRCLE ***
The circle activates. Whatever was closing in stops, recalculates, and reconsiders its options. One use. It is now just salt on the floor.
tokens.flavor_zork: The salt circle flares blue-white for exactly one second. Something backs off. The circle is spent -- it was always going to be one-time-use, the box said so.
